observations: White electric steam iron with a black soleplate.
The soleplate shows significant scuffing and wear, indicating heavy use.
The power cord is braided and appears to be in good condition.
The plug is a UK-style 3-pin plug.
The iron is shown resting on a tiled floor.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show significant scuffing and wear on the soleplate.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The heating element or thermostat may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the iron plugged in and heating up, with steam coming from the soleplate.

risks.risk: The soleplate may be scratched or have a damaged surface.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the soleplate surface.

risks.risk: The internal water tank may be leaking or clogged.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron boiling water and the tank filling without leaks.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the iron plugged in and heating up with steam.
Close-up photo of the soleplate to check for deep scratches or damage.
Video showing the water tank filling and boiling.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
